# DirectTools

> DirectTools is a family of five free web tools that move data directly between two devices over encrypted WebRTC. Pair with a six-character code or QR. No account, no upload, no stored copy.

## Tools

- [DirectFileShare](https://directtools.vercel.app/tools/file-share): Send files of any size between devices.
- [DirectTextShare](https://directtools.vercel.app/tools/text-share): Send text and links between devices.
- [DirectScreenShare](https://directtools.vercel.app/tools/screen-share): Share a screen, window or tab with another device.
- [DirectWebcam](https://directtools.vercel.app/tools/webcam): Use a phone as a webcam and document scanner.
- [DirectCall](https://directtools.vercel.app/tools/call): Private one-to-one voice and video calls.

## Apps

- https://directfileshare.vercel.app
- https://directtextshare.vercel.app
- https://directscreenshare.vercel.app
- https://directwebcam.vercel.app
- https://directcall.vercel.app

## Facts

- Free to use. No sign-up.
- Works in any modern browser on phone, tablet and computer.
- Content travels directly between the two browsers. No database and no accounts.
- Author: CodeWithVedang (https://github.com/CodeWithVedang)
